question: Who was the first female Jawan in the Indian Army?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shanti Tigga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shanti Tigga** was the first woman to join the Indian Army as a soldier (Jawan), breaking gender barriers in a male-dominated field.
 
• She joined the Indian Army in the year **2011** at the age of **35**, after clearing all tests and physical examinations.
 
• Shanti Tigga was a mother of two and worked as a railway employee before joining the Territorial Army.
 
• She outperformed her male counterparts in physical tests, completing a 1.5 km run in just **5 minutes and 5 seconds**, a remarkable achievement.
 
• Her selection marked a significant moment in Indian history, as she became a symbol of women’s empowerment and courage.&
